d.tr: I don't take WhatsApp video calls
d.ctx: The user asked what the expert does for a living. The expert mentions they don't take WhatsApp video calls, then the user asks if they do.
d.j: This is a denial of using an external app for video calls, which is a refusal of a platform move.

d.seg: व्हाट्सअप वीडियो कॉल यस हाँ जी कर लूँगा टू फिफ्टी लगेगा फुल ओपन शो करेंगे
d.tr: WhatsApp video call yes, I will do it, it will cost 250, I will do a full open show.
d.ctx: The user asks about WhatsApp video calls, and the expert agrees to do it for 250 and promises a full open show.
d.j: The expert is offering a sexual service (full open show) for a specific price (250) on an external platform.

d.seg: नंबर नाइन फाइव सेव कर लो
d.ctx: The expert is providing their phone number to the user to continue the conversation on WhatsApp.
d.j: The expert is providing a phone number to move the conversation to an external app.
